m: अ-शूद्र m. not a Śūdra, VS. xxx, 22; KātyŚr.
अ-शूद्रोच्छिष्टिन् mfn. not coming into contact with Śūdras or with leavings, ŚBr. xiv.
not giving the remnants of food to a Śūdra, Hir.
अ-शूला f. the tree Vitex Alata, L.

v: tri॰ na॰ ta॰ । ahIne pUrRRe “aSUnyaSayanaM BUyAnmama janmani janmani” SayyAdAnamantraH ।
a: अशून्य — a. 1 Not empty or vacant; तस्य निन्यतुरशून्यतामुभे R. 19. 13 occupied. --2 Not unattended to, fulfilled, executed; स्वनियोगमशून्यं कुरु (occurring frequently in dramas), execute or go about your business. --न्यं 1 Not a void. --2 Something sent to accompany another; लेखस्याशून्यार्थं किंचिदनुप्रेषितं Mu. 5; अयं लेखस्याशून्यार्थो भविष्यति ibid. (an accompaniment such as a customary present accompanying a letter). --Comp. --शयनं, --शयनद्वितीया, --शयनव्रतं N. of a certain ceremony or vow.

v: na॰ na SUnyaM SayanaM yasmAt । vrataBede । “asti vrataM mahApuRyamaSUnyaSayanaM nfpa!” ityupakramya “cAturmAsye BavedrAjan varzAyAm vratamuttamam SrAvaRasya dvitIyAyAM kfzRapakze narADipa! । SrAvaRAdikArttikAntaM kuryyAdvratamanuttamam” ityAdinA tasya viDAnamaBiDAya “caturvarzaM prakurvIta puruzoniyatendriyaH । evaM yaH kurute rAjanna SUnyaSayanavratam । na tasya SUnyA SayyA syAditi” ca hemA॰ vrata॰ Ka॰ BavizyapurARam ।
m: अ-शून्य—शयन n. the day on which Viśvakarman rests, VāmP.
अ-शून्य—शयन—द्वितीया f. N. of ceremonies on that occasion, MatsyaP.; BhavP. ii.

s: klI, (na SUnyaM SayanaM yasmAt, tat vratam .) SrAvaRakfzRadvitIyAkarttavyavrataviSezaH । yaTA, -- “brahmovAca । Bagavan ! puruzasyeha striyASca virahAdikaM । Soka-vyADi-BayaM duHKaM na Bavedyena tadvada ॥ BagavAnuvAca । SrAvaRasya dvitIyAyAM kfzRAyAM maDusUdanaH । kzIrArRave salakzmIkaH sadA vasati keSavaH ॥ tasyAM saMpUjya govindaM sarvvAn kAmAn samaSnute । go-BU-hiraRya-dAnAdi saptakalpaSatAnugaM ॥ aSUnyaSayanA nAma dvitIyA yA prakIrttitA । tasyAM sampUjayedvizRumeBirmmantrErvviDAnataH ॥ SrIvatsaDArin SrIkAnta SrIDAma SrIpate'vyaya । gArhasTaM mA praRASaM me yAtu DarmmArTakAmada ॥ agnayo mA praRaSyantu devatAH puruzottama । pitaro mA praRaSyantu matto dAmpatyaBedataH ॥ lakzmyA viyujyate devo na kadAcit yaTA BavAn । taTA kalatrasambanDo deva mA me viyujyatu ॥ lakzmyA na SUnyaM varada yaTA te SayanaM sadA । SayyA mamApyaSUnyAstu taTEva maDusUdana ॥ gItavAditranirGozaM devasyAgre tu kArayet । GaRwA BavedaSaktasya sarvvavAdyamayI yataH ॥ evaM sampUjya govindamaSnIyAttElavarjjitaM । naktamakzAralavaRaM yAvattatsyAccatuzwayaM ॥ tataH praBAte saMjAte lakzmIpatisamanvitAM । dIpAnnaBAjanEryuktAM SayyAM dadyAdvilakzaRAM ॥ pAdukopAnahacCatracAmarAsanasaMyutAM । aBIzwopaskarEryuktAM SuklapuzpAmbarAvftAM ॥ sopaDAnakaviSrAmAM PalErnAnAviDEryutAM । taTABaraRaDAnyESca yaTASaktyA samanvitAM ॥ avyaNgANgAya viprAya vEzRavAya kuwumbine । dAtavyA vedaviduze na vakavratine kvacit ॥ tatropaveSya dAmpatyamalaMkftya viDAnataH । patnyAstu BAjanaM dadyAt BakzyaBojyasamanvitaM । brAhmaRasyApi sOvarRImupaskarasamanvitAM । pratimAM devadevasya sodakumBAM nivedayet ॥ evaM yastu pumAn kuryyAdaSUnyaSayanaM hareH । vittaSAWyena rahito nArAyaRaparAyaRaH ॥ na tasya patnyA virahaH kadAcidapi jAyate । nArI cAviDavA brahman yAvaccandrArkatArakaM ॥ na virUpaM na SokArttaM dAmpatyaM jAyate kvacit । na puttrapaSuratnAni kzayaM yAnti pitAmaha ॥ saptakalpasahasrARi saptakalpaSatAni ca । kurvvannaSUnyaSayanaM vizRuloke mahIyate” ॥ iti matsyapurARe aSUnyaSayanavrataM 67 aDyAyaH ॥
